title: Server-Side Data Grid Transport & SQL Query Building
description: The ferrox-datagrid crate provides server-side data grid handling for Rust web frameworks. It translates frontend data grid request models (AG-Grid, TanStack Table) into optimized SeaORM / SQL queries with dynamic sorting, filtering, and pagination limits.
